what: Full index of all 923 oneshotprompts motion design techniques, grouped by kind -> subgroup. Each technique: id (use in prompts as {id}), name, live (has live example). One-sentence definitions: fetch https://oneshotprompts.com/techniques/<id>/ on demand (or check the site's 'Say it in plain words' aliases).
usage: Search this file (grep by name or id) to pick techniques for a motion spec; cite ids in the project's MOTION.md written in the oneshot text format (## Scene (3s) lines, - steps, [blanks], [words]{term-id} links, {term-id|strength=|speed=|when=|on=} settings). Format spec: https://oneshotprompts.com/llms.txt
